description: Mixed-compliance moto fleet (normal, slow centre riders, space-seeking custom1) with swarm red running, early start, queue space seeking and box-waiting illegal lefts; cars near-compliant.

driver_archetypes.rationale: Targets M3/share/car (0.0027) and M2/early/car (0.0011): near-default compliant car, no red driving, so car violation shares stay near zero; tau 1.0 keeps M1/car headway near 0.39 s.
Targets M1/car discharge headway (0.39 s) and M8/car wrong-lane share: shorter tau and higher lcAssertive give tighter discharge and slightly riskier lane changes.

Targets M1/moto (0.30 s), M4/overshoot_share (0.63) and M3/share/moto (0.092): small tau/minGap and sublane filtering push motorcycles past the stop line and shorten the queue (M5/length 13 m); moderate impatience with a drive-after-red time yields some red runners.
Targets M6/approach times (27-29 s moto vs 36 s car on l/s lanes) and the slow-rider share: lower speedFactor with higher speedDev gives slow centre-lane riders that raise approach time dispersion.

Targets M8/moto (0.25 wrong-lane share), M4/overshoot_depth (2.0 m) and M3/per_cycle (4.4 veh): assertive, lateral-aggressive riders (lcPushy 0.7, lcPushyGap omitted since SUMO ignores it when lcPushy is set) that may seek space and run red give violations and stop-line overshoot.

Targets M7a/n_waiting (5.5 veh), M7b/clear_lag (6.7 s) and M6/junction/illegal_l (49 s): illegal-left riders enter on own green and wait in the box; jmTimegapMinor 1.0 s keeps them yielding to the opposing stream until it ends.

traci_rules.rationale: Targets M2/early/moto (0.13) and M2/first_delay (2.1 s): creeping 8 s before green for ~15% of front-row riders reproduces the early-start share and shortens first crossing delay; cars excluded as M2/early/car is ~0.
Targets M3/share/moto (0.092), M3/per_cycle (4.4) and M3/var_to_mean (1.3): low base probability plus follower-driven increase gives clustered red runners, raising variance/mean above 1.

Targets F2 option probabilities (wrong_lane ~0.2 at q<40 m, right_lane ~0.03, sidewalk ~0.016), M8/moto, M9a (0.33/cycle) and M10a (0.27/cycle): trigger near the observed 13 m queue, with the observed option split and a 7 s green check.
Targets M7a/release_time (2.6 s) and M7b/clear_lag (6.7 s): a 1 s extra hold after native release lengthens box exit after the opposing green ends toward the observed lag.
Targets M4/lat_moto and M6 approach times: slow riders keep the lane centre, acting as moving obstacles that lengthen moto approach time without changing queue overshoot.
